status: New source-linked family for this routing study. Fictional workshop after the vote.
boundary: Workshop options are fictional agenda notes. They do not make a Security Council recommendation, decide United Nations membership, announce bilateral recognition, or change a delegate's recorded vote.

historical.fact: At its 9609th meeting the Council voted 12–1–2 on draft S/2024/312. France voted yes and the United Kingdom abstained. The negative United States vote prevented adoption.

historical.location: page 5, statement by Mrs. Broadhurst Estival
historical.fact: France supported elevating Palestine to full United Nations membership in the context of advancing the two-State solution.

historical.location: pages 6–7, statement by Dame Barbara Woodward
historical.fact: The United Kingdom linked its abstention to prioritizing an immediate humanitarian pause for aid and hostage releases, followed by work toward a sustainable ceasefire. It reaffirmed support for a two-State solution.
The draft would have recommended that the General Assembly admit the State of Palestine to membership in the United Nations.
Under the Charter, admission is a General Assembly decision upon a Security Council recommendation.
